sources.description: Satellite interpretation by Stimson Center and credited partners. Only the identified initial mining year is retained, with approximate annual precision. This inventory includes inactive sites; neither newer imagery nor a metadata update proves ongoing extraction. Unbounded '2015 or Older' dates are excluded.

sites.name: Mount Weld

periods.description: Lynas FY 2026 report confirms continued mining at Mount Weld, supplying its downstream plants. Only the mine is mapped; Malaysian and Kalgoorlie processing facilities are not counted as additional mines.

sites.name: Maoniuping

periods.description: A March 2026 government report explicitly identifies Maoniuping as a producing rare-earth mine. The new reserve estimate is not used as evidence of a new opening.

sites.name: Bayan Obo — rare-earth operation

periods.description: The March 2026 government comparison identifies Bayan Obo and Maoniuping as producing rare-earth mines. This rare-earth observation applies to 2026 only; it does not backdate rare-earth recovery across the older iron-mining period.

sites.name: Weishanhu

periods.description: The local mining-safety authority records a June 2026 visit to Shandong Weishanhu Rare Earth and inspection of underground working areas. This is an operating-site observation, without an assumed production quantity.

sites.name: Dalucao

periods.description: The state-owned mining group describes its January 2026 visit to Dalucao rare-earth mine staff and production-safety work. The current mine observation is separate from plans to enlarge processing capacity.

sites.name: Pela Ema — Serra Verde

periods.description: Serra Verde dates commercial production at Pela Ema to early 2024 and confirms the mine and processing operation continues in April 2026. Future capacity targets and the Round Top development project are excluded.

sites.name: Lovozero — Karnasurt

periods.description: The August 2026 government report describes underground work at Karnasurt and identifies Lovozersky GOK as mining and concentrating rare-earth-bearing loparite. The Solikamsk downstream refinery is not counted as another mine.

sites.name: OSCOM — Chatrapur

periods.description: The April 2026 parliamentary answer confirms IREL operates three integrated beach-sand mining and mineral-processing locations for its monazite/rare-earth chain. This is a current operation observation; downstream extraction and refining plants are not added as separate mines.

sites.name: Chavara

periods.description: The April 2026 parliamentary answer confirms IREL operates three integrated beach-sand mining and mineral-processing locations for its monazite/rare-earth chain. This is a current operation observation; downstream extraction and refining plants are not added as separate mines.

sites.name: Manavalakurichi

periods.description: The April 2026 parliamentary answer confirms IREL operates three integrated beach-sand mining and mineral-processing locations for its monazite/rare-earth chain. This is a current operation observation; downstream extraction and refining plants are not added as separate mines.
